items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: In 1928 I joined Leon René's band

ctx.x: In 1928 I joined Leon René's band, also at Belmon.
I think Mr. Leon René is the composer of that song, 'When the Swallows Come Back to Capistrano'.

items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: the last job I had with him was on New Year's Eve, 1928/ After that I didn't play with him anymore

ctx.x: Of course that job didn't last, he didn't make it go and so Leon didn't have much work and so the last job I had with him was on New Year's Eve, 1928/ After that I didn't play with him anymore because he didn't have any work.
Mr. Blakeney, tell us a little bit about the Sebastian Cotton
